faqs.question: When does school start in Duval County in 2026?
faqs.answer: The first student day is Monday, August 10, 2026. Employee planning on August 3-7 is before students return.

faqs.question: What is the last day of school for Duval students in 2027?
faqs.answer: Friday, May 28, 2027, is the scheduled last student day and end of the grading period. The year could extend if the district needs the June 1 or June 2 weather make-up dates, so keep those dates in mind before booking travel.

faqs.question: When is Duval’s Thanksgiving break in 2026?
faqs.answer: Students are off November 23-27. Schools close November 23-25, and schools and administrative offices close November 26-27. Including the weekends, the break runs November 21-29, with classes resuming Monday, November 30.

faqs.question: When do students return from winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Wednesday, January 6, 2027. Holiday closures run December 21-January 1, followed by employee planning on January 4 and professional development on January 5. December 18 is the final class day before the break.

faqs.question: When is spring break in Duval County in 2027?
faqs.answer: The school closure for Spring Break is March 15-19. Students also have no classes March 11 or 12 for staff days. Including the weekends, students are away March 11-21 and return Monday, March 22.

faqs.question: Is there school on October 12 and 13?
faqs.answer: No. Monday, October 12, 2026, is employee planning and Tuesday, October 13, is professional development. Students return Wednesday, October 14.

faqs.question: Are students off the Thursday and Friday after Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: No. November 11, 2026, is a school and administrative office closure, but November 12 and 13 are regular student days under the revised calendar.

faqs.question: Which other staff days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: Besides October 12-13, the student-free staff dates are January 4-5 and March 11-12, 2027. Keep them separate from the adjacent winter and spring school closures when checking the official entries.

faqs.question: Which legal holidays close schools during the regular student year?
faqs.answer: The calendar closes schools and administrative offices September 7 and November 11, 2026, and January 18, February 15 and March 26, 2027. Thanksgiving and winter closures are listed as separate date ranges. Memorial Day, May 31, falls after the scheduled last day and before the June weather reserves.

faqs.question: Is the March 26 holiday part of spring break?
faqs.answer: It is a separate closure. Students return from Spring Break on March 22 and have scheduled classes March 22-25. March 26 is a school and administrative office closure; March 29 is a conditional weather day, so a four-day late-March weekend is not guaranteed.

faqs.question: What are the weather make-up dates, and which is used first?
faqs.answer: The four reserves are March 29, April 26, June 1 and June 2, 2027. The district says it will use them in chronological order if weather-related closures require replacement instructional days. An unused reserve has no student classes. Follow district announcements for any activation.

faqs.question: Does Duval have early-release days in 2026-2027?
faqs.answer: The district’s back-to-school guide says there are no early-release days during 2026-2027. Staff training takes place on scheduled in-service days instead. Do not use an older year’s early-release calendar for pickup arrangements.

faqs.question: What time do Duval schools start and finish?
faqs.answer: The standard 2026-27 hours are 8:30 a.m.-3:00 p.m. for elementary, 9:30 a.m.-4:15 p.m. for middle and 7:10 a.m.-2:05 p.m. for high schools. Several schools have their own hours; use the school-specific exception rows before planning transportation.

faqs.question: Which school hours should Jean Ribault High families use?
faqs.answer: Confirm directly with Jean Ribault High. The district’s 2026-27 table and the campus contact page give different dismissal times, and Ribault appears as an exception to standard high school hours. The general 2:05 p.m. dismissal should not be assumed for this school.

faqs.question: When do grading periods end?
faqs.answer: The four published grading-period end dates are October 9 and December 18, 2026, and March 10 and May 28, 2027. These dates do not by themselves create an early dismissal or student holiday.

faqs.question: Where can I check report cards and progress reports?
faqs.answer: Use the linked Family Portal and Focus, along with school messages. The annual calendar lists grading-period boundaries rather than a complete report-card and progress-report release schedule; a reporting update does not automatically change attendance.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are on the revised calendar?
faqs.answer: There are 177 planned attendance weekdays within the August 10-May 28 schedule when the two in-year weather reserves remain unused. This is calculated from the listed dates, not an official annual total printed on the webpage. Actual attendance dates may change if weather make-up days are used.

faqs.question: Where can I find the official calendar and emergency updates?
faqs.answer: Use the official HTML calendar linked on this page. The district no longer posts a general public calendar PDF download. Follow Duval’s website, app and school messages for changes, and keep the parent account’s contact information current.

faqs.question: Does this calendar give the last day for seniors or graduation dates?
faqs.answer: The annual table does not give a separate 2027 senior endpoint or commencement schedule. Wait for the school’s senior and graduation notices; the prior year’s May senior dates and final-day dismissal announcement do not apply automatically.

editorialSummary.heading: A full Thanksgiving week and longer breaks around staff days
paragraphs: Duval students begin Monday, August 10, 2026, with the school year scheduled to finish Friday, May 28, 2027. The revised calendar gives students the whole week of November 23-27 off for Thanksgiving. It also places two student-free staff days on October 12 and 13, followed by a Wednesday return. November 11 remains a school holiday, while November 12 and 13 are regular attendance days under the revision. These changes matter when comparing a saved calendar with the district’s current schedule.

Winter classes end December 18. The holiday closures run December 21-January 1, followed by planning on January 4 and professional development on January 5; students return January 6. Before Spring Break, students are off March 11 and 12 for staff days, then remain out through the March 15-19 school closure and the following weekend. Classes resume March 22, with March 22-25 separating that break from the March 26 holiday. The district has no regular early-release dates this year. Weather make-up dates need a separate check, especially the June reserves after the scheduled last day.

faqs.question: What is Duval’s scheduled last day of school in 2028?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists Friday, May 26, 2028. It also lists weather dates on May 30 and 31, after the May 29 school closure. Confirm the final attendance schedule before making nonrefundable summer plans.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break in 2027?
faqs.answer: Schools are closed November 22-24, and schools and administrative offices are closed November 25-26. Students have the full November 22-26 week off. With the weekends included, the break runs November 20-28, with classes returning Monday, November 29.

faqs.question: When do Duval students return from winter break in 2028?
faqs.answer: The derived return is Wednesday, January 5, 2028. The school closures run December 20-31, 2027; January 3 is employee planning and January 4 is professional development. December 17 is the last scheduled class day before the break.

faqs.question: When is spring break in 2028?
faqs.answer: Schools and administrative offices close March 13-17, 2028. Employee planning on March 20 and professional development on March 21 follow the break. The continuous student no-class stretch runs March 11-21, with a return Wednesday, March 22.

faqs.question: Which planning and professional-development dates affect students?
faqs.answer: The in-year staff dates are October 11, 2027; January 3-4, 2028; and March 20-21. Plan for no regular student classes on those dates and check any separately scheduled program with the school.

faqs.question: Is there school on Labor Day or Veterans Day?
faqs.answer: Schools and administrative offices are closed Monday, September 6, 2027, and Thursday, November 11. No additional November 12 closure is listed on this calendar.

faqs.question: Are schools closed for Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day?
faqs.answer: Yes. The table closes schools and administrative offices January 17 and February 21, 2028. February 18 is separately listed as a Weather Day; confirm that Friday’s attendance instead of assuming a four-day Presidents Day weekend.

faqs.question: Is April 17 part of a guaranteed four-day holiday weekend?

faqs.question: Which weather dates are listed for 2027-2028?

faqs.question: When do grading periods end?

faqs.question: Are early-release days scheduled for 2027-2028?

faqs.question: What are school start and dismissal times for 2027-2028?
